# 313_R6FIX.42 — preview-orphan sweep gcs-bucket arm: storage.buckets.list custom role (run ledger)

- **Ticket:** `docs/tickets/313_R6FIX.42__sweep-buckets-list.md`
- **Branch:** `stevenvitali/r6fix-42-sweep-buckets-list` (on `origin/main` @ `2eb195ab`)
- **Harness:** devin-cli/swe-2-high · **Spend:** $0

## Log

- 2026-11-23 — resume survey found `preview-sweep` red every night 11-18 → 11-23 (the arm
  landed 11-17; the IAM update rode 11-17/18's stack updates). Failure is a single
  `SCAN-ERROR gcs-bucket`: `storage.buckets.list` denied on the github-pool principalSet —
  all other arms pass, so the binding matches and only the permission is missing.
- `gcloud iam roles describe` survey: `roles/storage.objectViewer` (the role the 11-17 code
  pinned as "the least role carrying it") does NOT contain `storage.buckets.list`; no
  predefined viewer does — only `roles/storage.admin`.
- Fix: one-permission `IAMCustomRole ciPreviewSweepBucketsList` (`storage.buckets.list`)
  bound to the same repo principalSet; `roles/storage.objectViewer` leaves the program.
  Its applied grant persists under `retainOnDelete` — the ticket records the one-shot
  `remove-iam-policy-binding` revocation for the deploy leg.
- `infra/pulumi/journeys.test.ts`: 4/4 — the pins now require the custom role + single
  permission and deny both predefined storage roles.
- Live verdict owed: next nightly `preview-sweep` after the apply (`gcs-bucket` arm lists
  buckets, no `SCAN-ERROR`).
- `pulumi preview --diff` on prod (2026-11-23): +IAMCustomRole, +IAMMember, −IAMMember
  `delete[retain]` (objectViewer — state-only; grant persists per the ticket's apply-time
  note), 194 unchanged, zero image/stateful churn. PR #404 carries the comment.
